summary: Optional sheets for the metrics-utility build_report command: ccsp_summary (customized with METRICS_UTILITY_PRICE_PER_NODE, REPORT_SKU, company, end user and PO number variables), jobs, managed_nodes, indirectly_managed_nodes, infrastructure_summary, inventory_scope and usage_by_organizations.
questions: What optional sheets can a metrics-utility report include?
How do I customize the CCSP summary page?

answer_card.title: Customize the CCSP summary sheet
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
export METRICS_UTILITY_PRICE_PER_NODE=11.55 # in USD
export METRICS_UTILITY_REPORT_SKU=MCT3752MO
export METRICS_UTILITY_REPORT_SKU_DESCRIPTION="Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Full Support (1 Managed Node, Dedicated, Monthly)"
export METRICS_UTILITY_REPORT_COMPANY_NAME="Partner A"
export METRICS_UTILITY_REPORT_END_USER_COMPANY_NAME="Customer A"
export METRICS_UTILITY_REPORT_PO_NUMBER="123"
```

These fill in the `ccsp_summary` landing page that `build_report` generates.
